prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1498; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has spoken with our client about the incident, please let us know so that we can address it.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a complete statement of the liability coverage available under the policy, including the per-person and per-accident policy limits, and written confirmation of those limits. Please also provide the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please ensure that no vehicle involved is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of without first giving us an opportunity to inspect it.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
